title: Scoped negative result: cross-block mixing retains the fixed complex late-interface floor
body:
**Scoped negative result; no new kappa.** Cross-block communication does not lower the complete helper-growth moment for the twelve fixed late interfaces in the selected PR1094 local word. For every 0 < s < 1, the exact minimum remains `328 + 56*2^s + 28*3^s + 20*4^s`, attained by the existing word.

This extends Ali Romman’s #1429 at `591582004d82302268da3b264a6ba5edec1521de`, which excludes cross-block communication. The proof permits arbitrary finite rational mixing of all 96 helpers, input reassignment and repeated fixed-port reads. New global checks confine high dirty information and rank-seven cancellation frames. An actual simultaneous boundary and two modular rank witnesses establish independence of all 192 source/helper coordinates.

Scope is essential: fixed early source values and late target frames, monotone frames, 96 helpers, full rank-nine endpoints and an unchanged exterior. Extra arrays, later source versions, earlier output access and frame descents remain outside the result. The written all-length argument is distinct from its finite premise checks; no full multiplication theorem, new supplier, native/global admission or selected cold replay is claimed.

Reproduce with Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-cross-block-locality
```

Expected: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/complex-cross-block-locality outcome=negative-result`.

Validation passed: source/Git pins; all 3060 local supports; 4560 input-frame pairs; 1056 foreign high/input and 4608 input/target checks; 24 cancellation frames; a separate set/integer-minor implementation with 240 scalar columns and boundary rank 192 over two primes; 12 built-in rejection controls; four corruption/read-only relocation tests; optimized Python 3.14 replays; selected-record and whitespace checks. The two implementations are by the same assisted author, not independent human review. Hosted CI status is separate.

Exact base: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`. OS assignment seed 33. Only `research/complex-cross-block-locality/` is added. Its README, proof and manifests contain the complete scope, immutable source identities, open next question and predecessor attribution. No frontier or frozen source changes.
